text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, everyone is formidable.
And—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Miracle-san... She's definitely gotten much stronger than before.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (The Mile Championship... If I want to secure an overwhelming victory, I need to grow even stronger than I am now.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was totally hyped, wasn't it crazy!?
That was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, Young Lady!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...So fun—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Miracle~~~~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Helios, Ruby!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My heart is beating so fast...
What is this feeling? How do I even put it into words?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Even Miracle-san...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Man, that was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What's up?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, why is everyone gathered here?
I believe our course is over that way.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on, who cares about the details!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aren't we total besties running in the Mile CS next?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's all go home together like good friends☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since we're on the same route, our target races overlapping
has nothing to do with how close we are as friends.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"That's not what I meant at all~!
Salt!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However... the waiting room is that way, and we're heading in the same direction.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Sharing that time together
should pose no particular inconvenience."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward her next major goal, the Mile CS,
today's race seemed to have given Daiichi Ruby
just the spark she needed.
